manual.revolver_cartridges.line2: Cartridges are created in the Engineer's Workbench, by the use of specific {0}Engineer's Blueprints{1}. Blueprints for normal ammunition you can create yourself, but some more advanced types will require you to buy adequate blueprints from {2}other engineers{3}.{4}
manual.revolver_cartridges.line3: {0}§lEmpty §lCasings§r and §lShells§r are the basis for every projectile. Empty Casings can also be crafted in the {1}Metal Press{2}, using the Bullet Casing mold, which reduces the copper required. Similarly, Empty Shells can be made out of {3}Phenolic Resin{4} in a bottling machine.{5}
manual.revolver_cartridges.line4: {0}§lCasull §lCartridges§r are created with a "Common Projectiles" blueprint. They are a simple lead projectile inflicting medium damage.{1}
manual.revolver_cartridges.line5: {0}§lArmor-Piercing §lCartridges§r are created with the same blueprint. They do the same amount of damage but penetrate armor by sheer kinetic force.{1}
manual.revolver_cartridges.line6: {0}§lBuckshot §lCartridges§r, created with the aforementioned blueprint, are filled with multiple small projectiles that are fired out in a cone shape. This cartridge is highly effective at short range.{1}
manual.revolver_cartridges.line7: {0}§lSilver §lCartridges§r, also created with a "Common Projectiles" blueprint, consist of a lead core wrapped in silver, making them highly effective against undead.{1}
manual.revolver_cartridges.line8: {0}§lHigh-Explosive §lCartridges§r are created with a "Specialized Projectiles" blueprint. They fire a projectile that explodes on impact, causing damage to living creatures and terrain.{1}
manual.revolver_cartridges.line9: {0}§lDragon's §lBreath Cartridges§r are created with a "Specialized Projectiles" blueprint. Similarly to Buckshot, they are effective at short range, but instead of small metal shots, they are filled with a flammable metal dust, creating a blast of flame.{1}
manual.revolver_cartridges.line10: {0}§lPhial §lCartridges§r are also created with a "Specialized" blueprint. They can be filled with any potion by crafting them together in a crafting grid and this potion will then be applied on impact. Normal potions require a direct hit, splash potions have an area of effect and Lingering Potions will create a temporary, lingering potion cloud.{1}
manual.revolver_cartridges.line11: {0}§lFlare §lCartridges§r are created with a "Specialized" blueprint. When fired, the flare explodes after a certain distance and then slowly sinks to the ground. You can combine the cartridge with dyes in a crafting table to change its colour.{1}
manual.revolver_cartridges.line12: {0}§lHoming §lCartridges§r are created with a "Specialized Projectiles" blueprint. Using the intriguing properties of an Eye of Ender, these projectiles gain the ability to seek out and chase the closest target.{1}They will not home in on players of the same team or animals tamed by the shooter or their teammates.
manual.revolver_cartridges.line13: {0}§lWolfpack §lCartridges§r are created with the same blueprint and consist of a collection of homing shots in a single shell. The initial projectile is unguided, but on impact splits into six target seeking shots, shredding surrounding enemies.{1}These projectiles also empower nearby wolves, loyal to the player, increasing their speed and damage.
